inspections.title: Care not given as ordered
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.

inspections.title: Suspected abuse or neglect not reported on time
inspections.detail: Timely report suspected abuse, neglect, or theft and report the results of the investigation to proper authorities.
inspections.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation

inspections.title: Pressure sores not prevented or treated
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate pressure ulcer care and prevent new ulcers from developing.

inspections.title: Pharmacist drug review not done properly
inspections.detail: Ensure a licensed pharmacist perform a monthly drug regimen review, including the medical chart, following irregularity reporting guidelines in developed policies and procedures.

inspections.title: Menus not meeting nutrition needs
inspections.detail: Ensure menus must meet the nutritional needs of residents, be prepared in advance, be followed, be updated, be reviewed by dietician, and meet the needs of the resident.

inspections.title: Food stored or prepared unsafely
inspections.detail: Procure food from sources approved or considered satisfactory and store, prepare, distribute and serve food in accordance with professional standards.

inspections.title: Nurse aides missing required dementia and abuse training
inspections.detail: Ensure nurse aides have the skills they need to care for residents, and give nurse aides education in dementia care and abuse prevention.

inspections.title: Initial care plan not done within 48 hours
inspections.detail: Create and put into place a plan for meeting the resident's most immediate needs within 48 hours of being admitted

inspections.title: Care not given as ordered

inspections.title: Psychiatric drugs not reduced or reviewed as required
inspections.detail: Implement gradual dose reductions(GDR) and non-pharmacological interventions, unless contraindicated, prior to initiating or instead of continuing psychotropic medication; and PRN orders for psychotropic medications are only used when the medication is necessary and PRN use is limited.

inspections.title: Family or doctor not told about a change or injury
inspections.detail: Immediately tell the resident, the resident's doctor, and a family member of situations (injury/decline/room, etc.)  that affect the resident.

inspections.title: Medication error rate of 5% or more
inspections.detail: Ensure medication error rates are not 5 percent or greater.

inspections.title: Significant medication error
inspections.detail: Ensure that residents are free from significant medication errors.

inspections.title: Medications not labeled or stored correctly
inspections.detail: Ensure drugs and biologicals used in the facility are labeled in accordance with currently accepted professional principles; and all drugs and biologicals must be stored in locked compartments, separately locked, compartments for controlled drugs.

inspections.title: Discharge notice not given
inspections.detail: Provide timely notification to the resident, and if applicable to the resident representative and ombudsman, before transfer or discharge, including appeal rights.

inspections.title: Bed-hold policy not explained
inspections.detail: Notify the resident or the resident’s representative in writing how long the nursing home will hold the resident’s bed in cases of transfer to a hospital or therapeutic leave.

inspections.title: Not enough nursing staff
inspections.detail: Provide enough nursing staff every day to meet the needs of every resident; and have a licensed nurse in charge on each shift.

openings.note: Estimate: certified beds minus average daily residents (CMS). Certified beds are often more than the beds actually staffed. Call to confirm.

bio: For-profit nursing home in Papillion with 48 certified beds. Provides 24-hour skilled nursing care, long-term care, and short-term rehab. Part of a continuing care retirement community, so residents can move between levels of care on one campus.
